item.title: UK tightens asylum system with 30-month reviews for refugees
item.description: THE UNITED KINGDOM’s changes to its asylum system came into force on Monday, the Home Office said. item.title: UK watchdog probes Hilton, Marriott and IHG over data-sharing concerns
item.description: HighlightsThe CMA is investigating Hilton, Marriott and IHG alongside data firm CoStar over alleged sharing of commercially sensitive information.The probe centres on CoStar's hotel benchmarking tool STR and the use of pricing algorithms. IHG shares fell 5 per cent on Monday, though wider market volatility linked to Middle East tensions also played a role.
